11 repositories merged the merge_group CI change and have an active merge-queue ruleset (squash, all-green, 5 entries); delete_branch_on_merge is set on all 14 organization repositories. The review requirement was relaxed only during the recorded break-glass.

Design 06 section 3 specifies organization reusable workflows, but 6 of 7 are still M1 skeletons (reusable-python, reusable-ros-build, reusable-contract-check, reusable-integration-mock, reusable-security, reusable-release). 0 of 12 product repositories call a reusable workflow; each keeps its own ci.yml.

The workspace moved to /home/jerichocheng/01_Projects/jcheng-robotics on 2026-11-27 (move record in 04_Archives/documents). The former /home/jerichocheng/jcheng path no longer exists, but AGENTS.md, the git workspace policy and git_preflight.sh still default to it.

limitations: Ecosystem v1.0 acceptance has not been attempted.
M5.2 S7 stale-state injection and S9 runtime publisher detection are not verified on hardware.
M6 S14 base, full G8 re-run and landing evidence are not run.
Mobile motion, mount pose and navigation are not verified; static /scan, /odom and /map pass.
Perception has one dual-view run and a wrist depth reader that can wedge; repeatability and multi-pose accuracy are not verified.
Operations failure drills are not run; the watchdog has never fired in a real wedge.
No hardware e-stop, brake, independent encoder or self-collision model exists; the platform is not safety-certified.
License status is not uniform: jcheng-mobile carries an MIT LICENSE retained pending review; the other new repositories have none.
Learning, simulation, studio, applications, benchmark and research are offline/mock/scaffold only; no hardware or motion claim is made for them.
Reviewer sign-off is pending; this report is a status record, not a signed acceptance.
The ecosystem lockfile still records release 2026.11.0-m3 and an empty modules map; the reproducible runtime combination covers only interfaces and the robot profile.
